title: I Left the Nameplate Photo on the Chair They Rolled to the Window

parts.text: I sat a named chair at 8:21 a.m. and it was at the window with someone else's hoodie. The hot-desk map said: NAMEPLATES STAY. HOODIES DON'T MOVE CHAIRS. I was twenty-eight, analyst, holding a plate that still said LEN. I photographed the plate, the map, and the hoodie. Owner of the hoodie, Jules, called it ergonomics. Ergonomics is a word hoodies use when a plate exists. I left the photo on Jules's monitor. Facilities rolled the chair back. Jules hoodies a guest chair. The window finally looks like a map, not a steal.

social.video_title: They rolled my named chair to the window — Part 1/1
social.description: Nameplate still, a hoodie, a rolled-back chair. Has ergonomics ever been your plate?
